title: ze_FFXII_Ridorana_Cataract
description: Here is another (this time a light) remake or remastered of one of our older maps. Rather than completely remake the gameplay from zero, we’ve simply brought some of our original ideas to life and update visual part (as we should have done many years ago). As a result, this version should appeal to both veterans and new players alike the map has plenty in store to surprise you! Huge thanks to Kuroki & Lolop & Tenshi for the work put into this port
